task_prompt: Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.55, 0.89, 0.94, 0.97, 0.65, 0.12, 0.19, 0.72] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
